|errata_history=This is the Players Committee's errata card image marked "E" (Holotable image set). (PC Errata 2)]]) reads "… use 1 Force to target an adjacent site where opponent has no presence. All your characters present in battle move away (for free) to the target site. The battle is canceled." The High-Res Scan is strangewayes' print-ready copy of this errata card (HiRez project), which has the same wording.

|rulings=* If some or all characters fail to move away, the battle will still be canceled.<ref name="scomp">[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Fall%20Back%21 Scomp: Fall Back!]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174249/https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json Internet Archive]</ref>
* Close The Blast Doors! will cause Light to lose 1 Force for each character that moves away, and then also lose 1 Force for canceling the battle.
* Characters inside open vehicles will automatically disembark to move away. Characters inside starships and enclosed vehicles are not present and so do not move away.
